items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Roy (Eldridge) was in the band and Teddy (Wilson) was in the band, and their brothers -- both had brothers, you know, and they were in the band.

ctx.x: Anyway, we got together, you know, with Speed, and Speed had very many promises, as they all do have. But nothing but promises. That's all. You dig? So we scuffled, and... Roy (Eldridge) was in the band and Teddy (Wilson) was in the band, and their brothers -- both had brothers, you know, and they were in the band.
Joe and Roy, and then Teddy and Gus. Gus played trombone, and he was a very great arranger. He was a good trombone player, too, but he was an excellent arranger.
